title: Melon Crumble
description: A sweet and refreshing dessert made with melon, topped with a crunchy crumble mixture.
instructions: Cut the melon into small cubes and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the crumble and melted butter until well combined.
Add the bitter chocolate chips to the crumble mixture and stir until they are evenly distributed.
Transfer the melon cubes to a baking dish and top with the crumble mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the melon is tender.
Serve warm, topped with additional bitter chocolate chips if desired.
